ValidationRule.description: When a PHOCS Drinking Water System Component has an Asset Type of Treatment, then related Asset Record Type must be PHOCS Treatment Method.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission ), /* Exclude Record Types */ NOT( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "DairyWorkerLicence", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSBCCDCDairyPlantLicence" ) ), NOT(ISBLANK( ParentId )), Parent.RecordTypeName__c = "PHOCSDrinkingWaterSystemComponent", TEXT( Parent.Type__c ) = "Treatment", RecordTypeName__c <> "Treatment_Method" )
